opening.eligibility_reason: [SYNTHETIC] Administrator authorizes a bounded individual review of a measured goal gap.
opening.opening_criteria: [SYNTHETIC] Conclusive compatible C04 and explicit individual human review; no universal commercial eligibility policy.
opening.closure_criteria: [SYNTHETIC] Historical goal <=60 min in both daily current windows, sufficient post-execution evidence, no unresolved relevant facts, and explicit human confirmation of these criteria.

cases.scenario: Prospective hypothesis, confirmation, real wait and insufficient post-execution evidence
Prospective authorization revision, natural expiry and approver role revocation
Correction of C05 evidence invalidates preparation and execution
Retrospective goal attained, explicit criteria and contradiction review, legitimate closure
Retrospective goal not attained, continued case and explicit new cycle
Late correction after C09 blocks closure and preserves earlier evidence
Inconclusive C04 cannot open a case
Documentary contradiction cannot open a case

limitations: A short prospective wait proves temporal enforcement, not recovery with a daily cadence or legitimate prospective closure.
Retrospective C05-C08 history is explicitly synthetic owner-loaded fixture data, not proof of past authorization, execution or elapsed observation.
C05 confirmation, textual plan conditions, eligibility and closure criteria require documented human interpretation; external documents are not certified.
No remote actions, automatic causality, universal commercial policy, closed-case reopening or historical contract migration are supported.
Revocation is exercised through current approver membership/role and plan replacement; no independent authorization revoke command exists.
